name: Printing the Squares of Numbers Within a Specified Range (Case 3)
description: Construct a program to write out the squares of every number between 20 and 25, both inclusive.

comments.content:
We need to repeat the same process for each of the integers between 20 and 25, both inclusive. To do this, we need to use a loop structure. We use for loops instead of a while loop because we need to repeat the loop a certain number of times, and for loops are best-suited in cases like this when we know ahead of time the number of times that we need to repeat the loop. Here, we want the for loop to start counting from 20 with every integer number up to (including) 25.

To do this, we initialize variable num to 20, loop until reaching 25 (inclusive), and increment num by 1 after each iteration of the loop.

In the first part of the loop header, we define a control variable num and initialize it to 20. In the second part of the loop header, we test whether the control variable has reached the termination threshold. The loop is repeated if the control variable is less than or equal to 25 and terminates when the control variable reaches 26. In the third part of the loop header, we increment the control variable by 1 after each iteration of the loop.

Note that the first part is executed once before the loop starts, the second part is executed before each iteration, and the third part is executed after each iteration of the loop. Also note that the increment operator (++) adds 1 to the value of variable num and the result is stored back into the variable num. Therefore, it is functionally equivalent to the statement num = num + 1.

In each iteration of the loop, this statement prints the square number to the default standard output stream. To square each number in the sequence, we multiply it by itself using the multiplication (*) operator.

Note that we do not necessarily have to store the squared number in a variable. The multiplication may also be performed directly in the println statement.
The expression in the argument of the println method returns a string that is obtained by concatenating the given string and value of the variables.
